road.else: Mrs Hale has your bag behind the bar. You won't get far without it.

parlour.name: Parlour
description: A low room with a fire. The yard is back out to the west.

description.text: The fire has burned down to embers.

purse.name: purse
purse.description: Your purse. Three shillings, which is all you have.

bag.name: travelling bag
bag.description: Your bag, with everything you own in it.

letter.name: letter
letter.initial: A letter addressed to you lies on the parlour table.

hale.name: Mrs Hale
hale.initial: Mrs Hale stands behind the bar.
hale.noTopic: "I wouldn't know about that," says Mrs Hale.

topics.text: "Your bag stays with me until the bill is paid," she says.
